plainLanguage: Kyle builds to the 2021 International Residential, plumbing and energy codes and the 2020 electrical code. Most new homes are in R-1-2 single-family zoning or in planned developments (PUDs) whose own rules and your plat set the setbacks - we could not verify the standard numbers, so check your plat. The city building permit is $500 plus 25 cents per sq ft plus a $75 plan review (about $1,285 for our 2,400 sq ft example with garage). Water and wastewater impact fees are high: up to $12,514 per home since December 2023. Kyle has no confirmed heritage-tree ordinance, but check before removing large oaks. Western Kyle may be over the Edwards Aquifer, where state water-quality rules apply.
